sections.title: Letter Pairs
sections.instruction: Trace the grey pair 2 times, then write it 1 time on your own.

sections.title: Three-Letter Words
sections.instruction: Trace the grey word 1 time, then write it 1 time on your own.

sections.title: Timing
sections.instruction: Trace the grey word 1 time, then write it 1 time. Tap ● one count for a haraka, ●● two counts for a madd.

sections.title: Four-Letter Words
sections.instruction: Trace the grey word 1 time, then write it 1 time on your own.

sections.title: Hamza
sections.instruction: Trace the grey word 1 time, then write it 1 time on your own.

sections.title: Madd
sections.instruction: Trace the grey word 1 time, then write it 1 time. The number shows how many counts to hold the madd.

sections.title: Qalqala
sections.instruction: Trace the grey word 1 time, then write it 1 time. Make the letter with sukoon bounce!

sections.title: Letter Shapes
sections.instruction: Look at each shape, then write it in the empty box next to it.
